name: Voice of Command
text: At the end of your Command phase, each OFFICER model with this ability may bark one Order at a friendly REGIMENT unit that has a model within 6 inches of it. The unit follows that Order until the start of your next Command phase, or until it becomes Battle-shocked. A unit follows one Order at a time; a new Order replaces the old one.

name: Move! Move! Move!
text: Order: every model in the unit has +3 inches added to its Move characteristic.

name: Take Aim!
text: Order: ranged weapons carried by models in the unit hit one step more easily (Ballistic Skill improved by 1).

name: Take Cover!
text: Order: models in the unit have their Save improved by 1, but never to better than 3+. Saves already at 3+ or better are unchanged.

name: Medi-pack
text: While the veteran carrying the medi-pack is alive, every model in that unit (an attached bodyguard included) has a 6+ Feel No Pain save.

name: Regimental Standard
text: While the veteran carrying the standard is alive, add 1 to the Objective Control of every model in that unit (an attached bodyguard included).

name: Rearm, Reload, Fire
text: While this unit is under an Order and stood still this turn, its Heavy weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

name: Mobile Hunter-killers
text: Attacks from this unit against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit may re-roll the wound roll.

name: Patrol Squads
text: When you declare battle formations, before any unit is set up, this unit may be split into two units of one model each. Each half keeps all of its abilities.
